description:
PROBLEM (benchbox-site main c97c2a9). User pages give wrong or incomplete setup instructions or make an ADR/design/development page the place an instruction lives. CHANGE (site repo; any merge to main deploys production): 1. BigQuery overview (docs/platforms/index.md:169-182): credentials are saved by `benchbox setup --platform bigquery`, which needs GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS and BIGQUERY_PROJECT, or ADC plus `gcloud config set project`; `benchbox run` reads saved credentials. 2. SNOWFLAKE_USER / REDSHIFT_USER and the setup flow: docs/platforms/index.md (~182), reference/cli/configuration.md:136, usage/faq.md:202 (credentials go through `benchbox setup --platform

`, not `benchbox platforms setup`), usage/troubleshooting.md:182,210: use SNOWFLAKE_USERNAME / REDSHIFT_USERNAME read by setup; `run` reads saved credentials. 3. ClickHouse Cloud page: add an OAuth section (`--platform-option oauth_token=` / CLICKHOUSE_CLOUD_OAUTH_TOKEN). 4. MCP reference: the user-relevant per-platform `platform_options` table inline (replacing 'authoritative matrix in docs/development/mcp-platform-option-contract.md' at mcp.md:312-315; contract stays as background); a Textcharts section (`pip install "textcharts[mcp]"`, command `textcharts-mcp`, a client config example with both servers, link to the upstream guide) replacing the design-page pointer at mcp.md:434; correct the error envelope at mcp.md:757-770 to `error_code`, `error_category`, `message`, `details`, `suggestion` (verify against benchbox/mcp/errors.py). 5. python-api/platforms/common.md:525 'PR #980' -> user terms. 6. ADR-only explanations: ducklake.md:11,238; reference/hosted-results-contract.md:72,455; reference/result-formats.md:184,255,262; reference/public-contracts.md:29,35,37; python-api/results.md:1178: state the user-relevant fact inline; keep the ADR link only as optional background. 7. Prevention: a narrow docs-contracts/checks/ rule (runs in `docs:check` in ci and deploy) rejecting backticked `docs/...md` source paths and 'PR #' on published pages outside development/, design/ and blog/.
